t: Farmer's Delight Mod (1.21.1, 1.20.1) - Farming Expansion for Minecraft - 9Minecraft.Net
s: September 22, 2025 - Farmer’s Delight Mod (1.21.1, 1.20.1) is a mod designed to enhance culinary crafting and agriculture. It introduces workstations, new crops, rustic tools, and fresh cooking recipes to enrich the survival experience. With this mod installed, players can grow cabbage, tomatoes, onions, and rice in their farms. These crops, along with vanilla ingredients, can be used to create new food dishes using pots, stoves, cutting boards, pantries, and more.
